notes: Mockup: frozen at atm dev 742105b64 (disclosure v2, #125). Bookings' day and week periods are chosen in the one period control of the top bar (S7 builds it); the pane only names the period.

Period hash grammar. S0's money period is month= (period.ts: YYYY-MM, or YYYY-MM-DD..YYYY-MM-DD); Bookings neither reads nor writes it, so the money period comes back when you leave Bookings. On #/<school>/bookings the period is range= and offset=: range is day or week (absent, or anything else: week); offset is an integer (absent or malformed: 0). range=day is the day offset days from the clock's today; range=week is Monday to Sunday, offset weeks from the week that holds today. Unlike month=, a Bookings period may lie after today (bookings ahead). The defaults are left out of the hash. The period control on the Bookings tab offers Today (range=day), Tomorrow (range=day&offset=1), This week (neither), Next week (offset=1), and its previous and next steps move offset by one and keep range; it keeps filter= and as=.
filter=outcome|approval|cutoff (absent: all) is the pane's chips; a period change keeps it.

View as: as=owner|finance|admin|governance|member|public (mockup SUBS); absent, it is the signed-in person's own (Vibes of Light: Kim R., owner; B4 Uni: Jo A., admin with the finance grant, so finance). A value the person may not preview is ignored (mockup vaAllowed: owner and finance only by the owner, admin by the owner or a finance admin, governance, member and public by anyone who holds that audience). owner, finance and admin see the pane; governance, member and public see only lock-panel (data-lock admins_only), because bookings follow ManageBookings, not the audience.

Data: src/data/bookings.ts. The Reader gives bookings({ school, from, to }) (brief A item 2 joined with brief D attendance); the overdue group is a second read over the 62 days that end the day before from. The Writer gives recordOutcome and cancelBooking; Confirm all attended is one recordOutcome per row of its group that needs an outcome, in row order. needsOutcome and insideCutoff in the contract are the only rules the UI applies.
root.dataset.route is set once the Bookings pane shows the route's list, or its lock panel.

booking-range-label is the pane's period name (mockup #bchips b: Today, Tomorrow, Yesterday, '<Wkd> <Mon> <d>', This week, Next week, Last week, 'Week of <Mon> <d>'); booking-range-dates is its dates followed by ' · change it in the period control'. booking-filter (data-filter all|outcome|approval|cutoff) carries class 'on' when selected; the chips count the shown range plus the overdue group.

booking-day is a group row (mockup tr.day) with data-day YYYY-MM-DD or overdue; booking-bulk sits in it with the same data-day when more than one of its bookings needs an outcome. booking-row is a booking (mockup tr.row) with data-booking; inside it booking-time (HH:MM, with '<Mon> <d> ' before it in the overdue group), booking-service (the service name only), booking-member (the attendee's name only, 'Guest' for a guest) and booking-status. booking-action (data-action confirm|noshow|release, data-booking) are the row's buttons: confirm and noshow when the booking needs an outcome, release on a confirmed booking that has not started. booking-empty is the 'Nothing booked on…' or 'No bookings…' line, booking-note the line under the table.

After a write starts, its row shows 'pending' in booking-status and no booking-action; the toast (the shell's, hooked toast) comes when the Writer answers. dialog is the modal (mockup #md), with dialog-title, dialog-confirm, dialog-cancel and, for a release inside the cutoff, the waive-cutoff checkbox; Escape closes it.

Not checked here: the period control itself (S7), the Billing column, the series badge ('weekly · 3 left'), Remind host, Cancel and refund on a paid booking, the toast's Undo and the dialogs' credit previews.
